solver_message:
Updated `scenes/main.tscn` with `Level/CoinHighlights` and six circular `Polygon2D` children named `CoinHighlight1` through `CoinHighlight6`.

Each highlight has a tight 13-pixel radius and 30% opacity, centered over one yellow star coin. Verified alignment in a Godot 4.4.1 render.
